Hi all — building on Naomi's note, here is the operational summary I suggest we include in the attestation: 

Operational controls for EuroClinical pilot (summary):
- No-training commitment: All requests and interaction data routed for the pilot will be processed in inference-only mode. We will not persist interaction data to training datasets, and no model weights will be updated as a result of pilot traffic.
- KV cache and ephemeral state: Token-level KV cache will be retained only for the duration of the session (configurable TTL; default 10 minutes) and will be purged after session termination.
- Request telemetry / logs: Diagnostic telemetry (latency, error rates) will be collected; content-level payloads will be stored only for the minimum necessary time (30 days) for debugging and compliance and will be purged unless EuroClinical requests retention. Audit logs will record access and admin actions; these logs will be available for export to customer-controlled SFTP.
- Onshore routing: For EU pilot customers we will route inference and logs to our EU region and will offer transfer of custody via SFTP to an EU-hosted storage endpoint.
- Subprocessors: For the pilot we expect to use the following subprocessors: "GCP Cloud Storage (eu-region)" (storage), "FastNet CDN (eu)" (edge routing), and our internal Redwood Dedicated inference pool (managed). A full inventory with contact-level details will be included in the SCCs pack.

Markus — can you confirm the attestation doc is ready to sign and that security will append the SCC pack?

Thanks,
David
